decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is cheap to maintain, close to the core shop offer, and publicly listed on the website, so the firm has little reason to abandon it after only one year.
The ERP interface plugin took substantial development effort and supports the announced multichannel integration direction, so it is the most strategically central of the six products.
This price comparison tracking plugin fits the firm's measurable-marketing positioning, and any weak uptake can still be blamed on the short time since launch.
Although it overlaps with the other price comparison plugins, it is already published and cheap to keep, so the firm is likely to keep it in the extension portfolio.
Like the other tracking plugins, it represents sunk development cost and a public commitment, so the firm is more likely to consolidate it than to remove it.
The net price reporting plugin complements Product A and supports the firm's analytics focus, so keeping it is easy to justify.
